summary: Default archive discovery now resolves the nearest Git repository root, including a Git-worktree .git file, before selecting its docs/atlas and sibling .github/docs/atlas. Previously, invocation from src or another nested directory could miss current archives and fall back to the packaged historical seed. The actual subprocess retrieval control checks both Git-directory and Git-worktree markers and finds the current shared record from a nested directory. Explicit --archive selection remains available for aggregation and private records. This source behavior does not establish that older installed helpers have been updated.
title: Resolve the owning repository before selecting Atlas archives
